raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an incorrect final conclusion by accepting a single, conflicting source (IMDb showing David Eady’s death as 1961) without cross-verifying, despite visible contradictions (another source indicating 2009 and an implausible “aged 84” for 1961). This failure to resolve the discrepancy and validate David Eady’s actual death date led to the wrong comparison; correctly, Condemned Women’s director (Lew Landers, died 1962) died earlier than Faces in the Dark’s director (David Eady, died 2009).
